name: Combobox
description: A filterable autocomplete input: typing narrows a popover listbox, highlights the matched characters and shows an animated empty state when nothing matches. The popover scales out of the field, flips above it near the viewport edge, and marks the selected option with a check.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA editable combobox with list autocomplete: the input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant, so DOM focus always stays in the input. The popup is role="listbox" of role="option" items with aria-selected. ArrowDown/ArrowUp open and move (wrapping), Alt+ArrowDown opens without moving, Enter selects, Escape closes and restores the text (or clears it when already closed). The empty state is a role="status" live region. The visible label is a real <label>. Under prefers-reduced-motion the popup only fades.

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the newly selected value (an empty string when cleared).

propsApi.name: open
propsApi.description: Controlled open state of the listbox.

propsApi.name: onOpenChange
propsApi.description: Called when the listbox requests to open or close.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Visible field label, used as the accessible name.

propsApi.name: emptyMessage
propsApi.description: Message shown (and announced) when no option matches.

propsApi.name: matchMode
propsApi.description: How the query is matched against options (case-insensitive).

propsApi.name: highlightMatches
propsApi.description: Highlight the matched characters in each option.

propsApi.name: showClear
propsApi.description: Show an animated clear button while the field has text.

propsApi.name: size
propsApi.description: Field and option height / type size preset.

propsApi.name: width
propsApi.description: Field width in pixels; the popover matches it.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of the match highlight, check mark and focus ring.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
